json.content:
Marlow Street Bakery

Hours Menu

Marlow Street Bakery

A small neighborhood bakery at 14 Marlow Street, on the corner by the library. Everything is baked on site every morning.

Hours

Tuesday to Friday
7:00 am to 3:00 pm
Saturday and Sunday
8:00 am to 2:00 pm
Monday
Closed

Menu

  • Country sourdough loaf$7.50
  • Seeded rye loaf$8.00
  • Butter croissant$3.75
  • Cardamom bun$4.25
  • Morning bun with orange zest$4.00
  • Sourdough focaccia slice$4.50
  • Filter coffee$2.75
  • Oat milk latte$4.75

The cardamom buns usually sell out by 11 am on weekends.

Baked every morning

Everything is baked on site every morning, starting at 4 am. Teo bakes the bread with a sourdough starter he has kept alive since 2016.

Marlow Street Bakery, 14 Marlow Street

Phone: (555) 014-2290

json.verdict: The page answers the three things Ines asked for at a glance: hours, prices and how to order a cake.

issues.text: The menu has no headings for bread, pastry and coffee; a long list is harder to scan on a phone.
There is no map link for the address.
